text:
maya: quick follow-up from the postmortemwe need concrete tests and owners. notes: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-21-kv-cache
samir: propose three lanes: regression (prompt sets + golden outputs), load (steady + spike), chaos drills (node/net/kv-evict). each needs a 90-day owner and triage playbook.

leah: i'll own regression. plan: extract top-15 customer prompts, mark 5 for CI-minimal, store golden token sequences and a semantic fallback.
maya: CI-minimal shape?
leah: minimal example config for evals harness (i'll PR):
```
evals:
  regression_ci_minimal:
    prompts_file: tests/evals/regression/minimal_prompts.json
    model: rdl-3b-quant
    compare: delta-checker
    timeout: 20s
```
enrique: i'll take load tests. nightly steady-state + spike scenario. use k6, terraform canary pool, grafana panels. alert if p95 or error-rate >15% vs baseline.

samir: chaos: monthly small randomized drills, quarterly full-scale. ops-bot can schedule monthly and post a summary. include pre-checks, traffic ramp, KV eviction sim, validation queries, rollback criteria.

ops-bot: Scheduled: monthly-chaos-drill at 2026-04-15T03:00Z. Will post summary to #incidents.

maya: action items (owners + due dates):
- leah: curate top-15 prompts; add CI-minimal (5) + nightly full (15); open PR with delta-checker  due 2026-04-04 (ticket #4905)
- enrique: implement nightly load jobs + make target + grafana alert  due 2026-04-10 (ticket #4906)
- samir: draft chaos runbook + ops-bot automation  due 2026-04-06 (ticket #4907)
- maya: add rollout gate to CI to block model rollouts until regression_ci_minimal passes  due 2026-04-03 (ticket #4908)

leah: opening PR now and will tag reviewers. will include token-diff and semantic similarity threshold (cosine >= 0.92).
enrique: pushed terraform skeleton to infra/canaries and a stub k6 script to ci/load-scenarios. will post dashboard link after panels live.
samir: draft chaos runbook in ticket and will iterate with devops/sre. includes rollback commands and emergency contacts.
maya: set milestones on tickets and weekly check-ins until tests ship. i'll run a 10-min sync next Tue. ops-bot: remind 2026-03-31 to collect progress.

ops-bot: Reminder set for 2026-03-31 to collect progress updates.
